product.title: Full-Day Tour Exploring the Waters of Tolantongo

description.text: A 14-to-16-hour guided day from Mexico City reaches the thermal pools, river, and caves at Tolantongo. Breakfast, snacks, private transportation, and a sport-towel kit are included, with an English-speaking guide on the highland drive. Stops include Angel of Independence, Actopan, Tolantongo, Grutas Tolantongo. The meeting point sits on the Reforma rotunda facing the Angel of Independence, nearest the Sheraton Maria Isabel. Ideal for visitors basing in Mexico City who want a long thermal-canyon day without self-driving the Hidalgo route.
